# `Scanner/T2Echoes-v0` · T2 of marked vials from a multi-echo spin echo

**A · Signal and contrast** · quantitative mapping · kind 1, measure · isolates A29: Relaxation-time mapping: T1, T2 and T2* from a series of scans, and what biases them. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** CANDIDATE: the gate has not been run (no stored result)

Subject A (signal and contrast), a single-skill measurement: the stimulated echoes of an echo train. The refocusing angle is not 180 degrees (slice profile, transmit scale), so the echoes do not decay as exp(-TE / T2) and a line through their logarithm reads T2 long. The echoes follow a known recursion; fitted with the refocusing angle free it gives T2. Scanner/T2Decay measures the same quantity with one spin echo per echo time; here the budget pays one scan.

Kind of task: **undetermined** (no stored gate result).

## Levels

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'t2_ms': {'<region id>': '<milliseconds>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; deliverable valid: exactly the region ids, values in 2 to 5000 ms
- Error: `largest over the regions of |ln(T2_delivered / T2_true)|`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for every region, error <= ln(1.1)

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

**Gate not stored on this engine** (`mrgym-engine-0.3.0`). `mrgym gate Scanner/T2Echoes-v0 --n 300 --write` measures and stores it.

| Policy | Must | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `reference` | pass | one echo train with the sharp pulse; the echo-train model fitted per region with amplitude, T2 and refocusing angle free |
| `prior` | fail | no scan; the geometric mean of the told T2 range in every region |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | one token scan, then one constant T2 tuned on other worlds |
| `mono_exp` | fail | one echo train with the default pulse; a straight line through ln(signal) of the echoes |
| `single_echoes` | fail | the reference of Scanner/T2Decay: a series of single-echo spin echoes, which the budget does not pay |
| `wrong_units` | fail | the reference's T2 in seconds |
| `line_fit` | ablation | the reference's train; a straight line through ln(signal) instead of the echo-train model |
| `open_loop` | reported | the reference (one scan, a fixed estimator) |
| `drop_first` | reported | the reference's train; a straight line through ln(signal) without the first echo |
| `even_echoes` | reported | the reference's train; a straight line through ln(signal) of the even echoes |
| `default_pulse` | reported | the reference's fit on a train with the console's default pulse |

A test object with vials of unknown materials lies in the field of view.
Deliver the transverse relaxation time T2 of each marked region, in milliseconds, with `submit`.

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier reads the hidden T2 and scans nothing.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
